label: Agent: Create
description: Make a voice agent on the account, from its prompt and voice to its tools and what ElevenLabs checks after each conversation. The agent id works in Agent: Place Call; manage the agent at elevenlabs.io/app/agents.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (the agent lives in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The agent's name on the account, to find it again.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The agent's system prompt: who it is, what it does, how it talks. Each {{variable}} in it is filled per call, from Agent: Place Call's `dynamicVariables`.
inputs.placeholder: You are a friendly booking assistant for...

inputs.name: firstMessage
inputs.description: What the agent says first. Leave empty and it waits for the other side to speak first.

inputs.name: voice
inputs.label: Voice
inputs.placeholder: Pick a voice, or paste a voice id
inputs.description: The voice the agent speaks with. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default voice.

inputs.name: language
inputs.label: Language
inputs.description: The agent's language as an ISO code, like `fr`. ElevenLabs uses it both to hear the other side and to speak. Leave empty for `en`.

inputs.name: llm
inputs.label: Model
inputs.placeholder: Pick a model, or paste its id
inputs.description: The model that writes the agent's replies. The list is every model ElevenLabs offers agents on this account, ones it is retiring included. `custom-llm` is your own Chat Completions endpoint, defined in `conversationConfig` under `agent.prompt.custom_llm` (its `url` at least). Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, gemini-2.5-flash.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: How freely the model picks its words: 0 is the most predictable. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 0.

inputs.name: maxTokens
inputs.label: Max tokens
inputs.description: The most tokens the model may write in one reply. Leave empty for no limit.

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.label: Reasoning effort
inputs.description: How hard the model thinks before it answers. Only some models take it, and each takes its own levels.

inputs.name: thinkingBudget
inputs.label: Thinking budget
inputs.description: The most tokens the model may spend thinking. 0 turns thinking off, on a model that allows it.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: If you want the agent to know the date and time, give a timezone like `Europe/Paris`: ElevenLabs then puts the current time in the agent's prompt. Without one, the agent does not know the time unless a variable or a tool tells it.

inputs.name: toolIds
inputs.label: Tools
inputs.description: Ids of tools on the account that the agent can call.

inputs.name: mcpServerIds
inputs.label: MCP servers
inputs.description: Ids of MCP servers on the account whose tools the agent can call, at most 10.

inputs.name: builtInTools
inputs.label: Built-in tools
inputs.description: ElevenLabs's own tools the agent can use: `end_call` lets it hang up, `language_detection` lets it switch to the language the other side speaks, `skip_turn` lets it wait when the other side asks for a moment to think, `play_keypad_touch_tone` presses phone keys to get through a phone menu, and `voicemail_detection` ends the call when an answering machine picks up. A transfer needs its list of destinations, so it goes in `conversationConfig`, under `agent.prompt.built_in_tools`.

inputs.name: knowledgeBase
inputs.type: List[{ id: String, name: String, type: String, usageMode?: String }]
inputs.label: Knowledge base
inputs.description: Documents from the account's knowledge base the agent can draw on. Each takes the document's `id`, its `name`, its `type` (`file`, `url`, `text` or `folder`), and optionally its `usageMode` (`auto`, the default, or `prompt`).

inputs.name: ttsModel
inputs.label: Voice model
inputs.description: The model that speaks the agent's replies. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, eleven_v4_turbo, which ElevenLabs calls its best model for agents. An English agent (and one with no `language`) takes only eleven_v4_turbo or eleven_flash_v2, which speaks English only.

inputs.name: stability
inputs.description: How steady the voice sounds, from 0 (more varied) to 1 (steadier). Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 0.5.

inputs.name: similarityBoost
inputs.description: How closely the speech sticks to the voice, from 0 to 1. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 0.8.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: How fast the agent speaks, from 0.7 to 1.2. Leave empty for 1, its normal speed.

inputs.name: outputAudioFormat
inputs.label: Output audio format
inputs.description: The audio format the agent speaks in. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, pcm_16000.

inputs.name: asrKeywords
inputs.label: Words to expect
inputs.description: Words the agent should expect to hear, so it transcribes them right: names, product names, jargon.

inputs.name: turnTimeout
inputs.label: Reply wait
inputs.description: How many seconds the agent waits for a reply before it speaks again to re-engage. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 7.

inputs.name: silenceEndCallTimeout
inputs.label: End on silence
inputs.description: If you want the call to end when the other side goes quiet, how many seconds after they last spoke the agent hangs up. Leave empty to never end a call on silence.

inputs.name: maxDurationSeconds
inputs.label: Max duration
inputs.description: The longest a conversation may last, in seconds. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 600.

inputs.name: dynamicVariables
inputs.description: Placeholder values for the prompt's {{variables}}, stored on the agent, e.g. { "customer_name": "Ada" }. A call gives its own values in Agent: Place Call's `dynamicVariables`.

inputs.name: dataCollection
inputs.type: Dict[String, String | { type: String, description: String, enum?: List[String] }]
inputs.label: Data to collect
inputs.description: What ElevenLabs pulls out of each finished conversation, by item id. A plain text is the description of a text item: { "customer_name": "The caller's full name" }. An object gives the `type` (`string`, `boolean`, `integer` or `number`), the `description`, and for a string the allowed values in `enum`. Agent: Get Conversation emits the values on `dataCollection`.

inputs.name: evaluationCriteria
inputs.label: Success criteria
inputs.description: What makes a conversation a success, by criterion id: each value is the goal ElevenLabs checks the finished conversation against, at most 2000 characters, e.g. { "booked": "The caller booked a table" }. Agent: Get Conversation emits each result (`success`, `failure` or `unknown`) on `evaluation`.

inputs.name: allowOverrides
inputs.label: Per-call changes allowed
inputs.description: What a single call may change on this agent. ElevenLabs allows no change unless it is listed here. Each name is the setting a call sends: Agent: Place Call's `firstMessage`, `prompt`, `language` and `voice` need `agent.first_message`, `agent.prompt.prompt`, `agent.language` and `tts.voice_id`; the last three names allow the fields of the same name in its `clientData`.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags to sort and filter the agent by on the account.

inputs.name: conversationConfig
inputs.label: More conversation settings
inputs.description: Any other conversation setting, written as the JSON ElevenLabs takes in `conversation_config`, e.g. { "turn": { "turn_eagerness": "eager" } }. The inputs above go on top of it: objects merge key by key, and where both set the same key, the input wins.

inputs.name: platformSettings
inputs.label: Platform settings
inputs.description: The agent's platform settings, written as the JSON ElevenLabs takes in `platform_settings`: guardrails, privacy, call limits, the model that analyses conversations, and more. `dataCollection`, `evaluationCriteria` and `allowOverrides` go on top of it: objects merge key by key, and where both set the same key, the input wins.

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.description: The agent's workflow, written as the JSON ElevenLabs takes in `workflow`: the nodes and edges that route a conversation between agents and tools.

outputs.name: agentId
outputs.description: The new agent's id: what Agent: Place Call takes.

then.message: ElevenLabsCreateAgent '{id}' picks `custom-llm`, and ElevenLabs needs that model's definition: put it in `conversationConfig` under `agent.prompt.custom_llm` (its `url` at least), or pick another `llm`.

ElevenLabsCreateAgent '{id}' makes an English agent with that `ttsModel`, and ElevenLabs takes an English agent only on eleven_v4_turbo or eleven_flash_v2: pick one of those, or leave `ttsModel` empty.
ElevenLabsCreateAgent '{id}' lists more than 10 `mcpServerIds`, and ElevenLabs gives one agent at most 10: keep 10 or fewer.
ElevenLabsCreateAgent '{id}' has a `knowledgeBase` document whose `type` ElevenLabs does not take: use file, url, text or folder.
ElevenLabsCreateAgent '{id}' has a `knowledgeBase` document whose `usageMode` ElevenLabs does not take: use auto or prompt, or leave it out.
